decisions.decision: The Board intends to extend the current recreational marijuana moratorium over the winter to work through the regulatory process, with a single phase of licensed non-medical adult marijuana discussed at each meeting.
decisions.quote: the board intends to extend the current moratorium over the winter to work through the regulatory process

decisions.decision: A marijuana discussion timeline was set: September 10 Retail; September 24 Cultivation; October 22 wrap up; November 5 Processing and Testing Labs; November 26 Craft Cultivator; December 10 Transporter.

decisions.decision: A. Burney will seek guidance from Town Counsel on the marijuana regulations.
